title: 鉴园 Jian Yuan
subtitle: Changchun Yuan

model.line: 9 boxes stand in this compound, 9 on blocks drawn on the plan, 0 assumed. Its halls are listed below.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 映清斋、鉴园
evidence.excerpt_zh: 玉玲瓏館之南為昭曠亭亭東南為映清齋齋東為鑑園敞宇五楹西嚮北為潄瓊齋其東為師善堂（長春園册）臣等謹案鑑園之後有船塢
evidence.summary: South of 玉玲瓏館: 昭曠亭, then 映清齋; east of it 鑑園, a five-bay range facing west, with 潄瓊齋 and 師善堂, and a boathouse behind.

evidence.title: 御製 鑑園
evidence.excerpt_zh:
鑑園
如園轉北鑑園通遂向溪堂坐憩躬且喜夏來齊葉緑那憐春去減花紅圖書趣寄崇情表景物竒叅跬步中鑑已鑑人胥有事顧名思義儆無窮
evidence.summary: North from 如園 is 鑑園, with a hall on the stream.

evidence.title: 御製 鑑園
evidence.excerpt_zh:
鑑園
如園至鑑園葢弗勞數武因各據殊勝異名稱（去聲）其所是處水周遭樓臺鏡中覩無塵清淨界有象琉璃宇偶憶文皇言不覺意為憮
evidence.summary: 如園 to 鑑園 is only a few steps. Water runs all round, and the terraces are seen in it as in a mirror.

evidence.title: 漱琼斋
evidence.locator: v4 p.107, under 鉴园; source ref 5-190
evidence.excerpt_zh: 临泉搴荔帏，迸水上苔矶。净响真宜耳，寒光欲湿衣。鱼恬心不跃，鸟惜影忘飞。王济曾何谓，于斯辨是非。
evidence.summary: Poem 漱琼斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1754, filed by the editors under 鉴园.

evidence.title: 漱琼斋
evidence.locator: v4 p.107, under 鉴园; source ref 8-587
evidence.excerpt_zh: 复降寻崖际，水斋坐潄琼。何来金石响，绝胜管弦声。不舍科盈进，有源渠自成。底须三百丈，一例涤尘情。
evidence.summary: Poem 漱琼斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1762, filed by the editors under 鉴园.

evidence.title: 漱琼斋
evidence.locator: v4 p.109, under 鉴园; source ref 9-431
evidence.excerpt_zh: 澄观是空还是色，静聆非竹亦非丝。鸣球即在溪堂侧，戛击何须更藉夔。
evidence.summary: Poem 漱琼斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1768, filed by the editors under 鉴园.

evidence.title: 师善堂
evidence.locator: v4 p.108, under 鉴园; source ref 9-409
evidence.excerpt_zh: 溪水面前横，堂廉日俯清。万殊参一本，物理即人情。有照原无意，常流故不盈。会心额师善，陈戒缅阿衡。
evidence.summary: Poem 师善堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1768, filed by the editors under 鉴园.

evidence.title: 题师善堂
evidence.locator: v4 p.108, under 鉴园; source ref 9-422
evidence.excerpt_zh: 力学在择师，宜师莫如善。为之著周誓，积斯训羲典。于从毋畏难，其乐固弗浅。彰里吾应祗，转圜吾应勉。顾名思义多，讵曰兹游衍。
evidence.summary: Poem 题师善堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1768, filed by the editors under 鉴园.

evidence.title: 鉴园: 乾隆三十八年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆三十八年 (1773), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 如园转北鉴园通，遂向溪堂坐憩躬。且喜夏来齐叶绿，那怜春去减花红。图书趣寄崇情表，景物竒叅跬步中。鉴已鉴人胥有事，顾名思义儆无穷。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 鉴园, 1773. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 师善堂
evidence.locator: v4 p.113, under 鉴园; source ref 12-669
evidence.excerpt_zh: 书云主善为，易曰元善长。人有能不能，凡善皆宜仿。取诸人为善，重华堪景仰。要复在克己，德量乃能广。五言识所存，协一勉毋两。
evidence.summary: Poem 师善堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1775, filed by the editors under 鉴园.

evidence.title: 鉴园
evidence.locator: v4 p.113, under 鉴园; source ref 12-829
evidence.excerpt_zh: 如园至鉴园，盖弗劳数武。因各据殊胜，异名称其所。是处水周遭，楼台镜中睹。无尘清净界，有象琉璃宇。偶忆文皇言，不觉意为怃。
evidence.summary: Poem 鉴园 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1776, filed by the editors under 鉴园.

evidence.title: 鉴园: 乾隆四十一年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆四十一年 (1776), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 如园至鉴园，葢弗劳数武。因各据殊胜，异名称其所。是处水周遭，楼台镜中覩。无尘清净界，有象琉璃宇。偶忆文皇言，不觉意为怃。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 鉴园, 1776, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 鉴园: 嘉庆元年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆元年 (1796), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 鉴水灵台净，光明方寸中。观澜诚有术，知止自能通。印月烛圆镜，披云见太空。勤修须内照，三省验吾躬。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 鉴园, 1796, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 鉴园
evidence.locator: v4 p.117, under 鉴园; source ref 1-342
evidence.excerpt_zh: 鉴物先鉴我，内省克己功。寸田养宥密，机发千里同。韬光细磨炼，精采蕴乎中。惟明视斯远，主敬听则聪。屋漏苟不愧，外诱鲜蔽蒙。其本在好问，纳诲务虚衷。妍媸彼自照，洞彻存大公。
evidence.summary: Poem 鉴园 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1798, filed by the editors under 鉴园.

evidence.title: 鉴园: 嘉庆三年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆三年 (1798), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 鉴物先鉴我，内省克已功。寸田养宥密，机发千里同。韬光细磨炼，精采蕴乎中。惟明视斯远，主敬听则聪。屋漏苟不愧，外诱鲜蔽蒙。其本在好问，纳诲务虚衷。妍媸彼自照，洞彻存大公。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 鉴园, 1798, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 鉴园: 嘉庆十五年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆十五年 (1810), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 旧园未拈咏，修葺新品题。长春极东境，虚廊面清溪。波光印林影，漪澜接碧堤。西山滴飞翠，秀峙星汉齐。众妙聚一室，纳景水殿低。澄心鉴物理，静默寻端倪。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 鉴园, 1810, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 鉴园: 嘉庆十五年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆十五年 (1810), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 芳墅涵长空，朗鉴印清景。林虚云有光，水远波无影。皎旭辉楼台，金碧耀藻井。泬寥万里澄，群笏排西岭。槛前列翠屏，延赏游目骋。胜概本人成，高爽卷阿境。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 鉴园, 1810, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 鉴园: 嘉庆十六年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆十六年 (1811), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 园额义深远，鉴古始治今。艰哉御六合，恭已勉君临。哲后事迹列，择取矢寸忱。辨别圣狂念，殊途养素心。存仁斯达道，立纲欲不侵。本原守勿失，册府时探寻。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 鉴园, 1811, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: Site status table, about 2011: scattered remains only
evidence.summary: Scenes with only scattered, incomplete building remains in the same table. 方壶胜境 is listed separately as the one with fairly complete remains not yet tidied up. 紫碧山房, 舍卫城 and 如园 have been dug since.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 鉴园
evidence.summary: Seven short visits, 1773-1811, on water views; nothing on the form of its halls. 鉴园: 7 dated items, 1773-1811, of which 7 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing); recurring themes: the view. First dated 1773, last dated 1811.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 鉴园
evidence.summary: Of 1767, after 趣园 at Yangzhou, on the long lake north-east of 如园. A five-bay open hall faces west; 开益轩 and five-bay 漱琼斋 lie north, 师善堂 east, 芳晖楼 and 绿净榭 south, with a large boat dock behind.

evidence.title: 海岳开襟; 映清斋; 蒨园; 鉴园; 狮子林 (search-index text)
evidence.summary: 海岳开襟: lake islet about 90 m across, about 1,000 m2 of buildings, by 1747, repaired 1778 and 1791; a totem park stood here 1995-2007. 映清斋: added 1766 as a new palace of 玉玲珑馆. 蒨园: 6,600 m2, 2,300 m2 of buildings, 1752. 鉴园: repaired 1810. 狮子林: west part with 丛芳榭 by 1747, the east in imitation of Suzhou finished 1772.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
